waypoints.name: Cathedral Rock Trailhead (Trail #1345)
waypoints.directions: From I-90 take Exit 80 (Roslyn/Salmon la Sac), about a mile west of Cle Elum, and follow Bullfrog Road to the roundabouts, then SR-903 north through Roslyn and Ronald along Cle Elum Lake — roughly 14.8 miles to the end of maintained pavement just past the Salmon la Sac guard station. Continue onto gravel Cle Elum Valley Road (FR 4330) for 12.3 miles, then bear slightly left onto the short NF-153 spur to the Cathedral Rock trailhead for Trail #1345, at about 3,350 feet. Sign the free self-issue wilderness permit at the register before you start walking.

waypoints.name: Nosh Nosh Wahtum (formerly Squaw Lake)
waypoints.directions: Take Trail #1345 west, crossing the Cle Elum River on a footbridge near the start, then climb steadily through old-growth forest. Continue straight at the Trail Creek Trail #1332 junction at about 2 miles; the trail reaches Nosh Nosh Wahtum along the lake's northeast shore at about 2.5 miles.

waypoints.name: Cathedral Pass / Pacific Crest Trail junction
waypoints.directions: Continue on Trail #1345 past the lake into subalpine meadow and blueberry slopes, with Cathedral Rock ahead, then switchback up steeper, rockier tread to Cathedral Pass and the Pacific Crest Trail junction at about 5,550 ft, roughly 4 miles from the car.

waypoints.name: Cathedral Rock summit
waypoints.directions: Leave the trail at the pass and work up broken talus, heather benches and easy rubble on the south and southeast flank to the base of the tower. Climb the chimney cleft cutting the southeast face, left of the Southwest Face route, on gritty, fractured rock with thin protection, then follow the broken ridge crest and a short scramble to the summit boulder.
